GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 800.217 (9 Nov 46) NR
(SCAPIN-1329)
APO 500
9 November 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Additional Personnel To Accompany the 1946-47 Japanese Antarctic Whaling Expedition.
1. Reference to Memorandum from Imperial Japanese Government dated 2 November 1946, file C.L.O. No 5829(EA) to General Headquarters of the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, in which authorization is requested for certain additional personnel to accompany the 1946-47 Japanese Antarctic Expedition.
2. The two weather observers, as listed in the subject reference, are authorized to accompany the expedition to make meteorological observations to facilitate the whaling operations. These ▲ervers will comply with instructions be furnished by the ▲erd Weather Wing.
3. The marine engineer, as listed in the subject reference, is authorized to accompany the expedition.
4. The photographer, camera-men and correspondents, as listed in the subject reference, are not authorized to accompany the expedition.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
